Title: Azure HDInsight for Apache Kafka 3.2.0 is now available for public preview.

Body.Content: After notable improvements in performance and stability, Azure HDInsight for Apache Kafka 3.2.0 now available for public preview and ready for production workloads. The essential changes include features and improvements. Review the official release notes and migration guidelines to assess potential changes to your applications.
